{{Quote|We're almost through. Bring in the flamethrowers.|[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], during the Second Battle of Geonosis|<ref name="Landing at Point Rain">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref>}}
The '''flame troopers''' were a special branch of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that specialized in the use of [[BT X-42 flamethrower|BT X-42 heavy Republic flamethrowers]] as well as other incendiary weapons. Flame troopers wore specialized [[Armor/Legends|armor]] designed to counter heat that they were often in. They were present during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]]. Their successors were the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Incinerator stormtrooper/Legends|incinerator stormtroopers]].

==History==
During the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and [[Special ops clone trooper/Legends|special ops clone trooper]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Jet/Legends|Jet]] led a group of [[Special forces/Legends|special ops]] troopers and flame troopers in a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] to reach the landing zone. The squadron of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] along with Mundi had been shot down by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] resistance, which caused the clones to crash, resulting in heavy casualties. The clones were later fighting off the Geonosians in one of the [[Cave/Legends|caves]] in which the Geonosians were hidden. As the clones almost broke through the Geonosian crossfire, Mundi summoned the flame troopers to burn the rest of the Geonosians so [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|forces]] could move in to assist [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] at the landing zone.
